note: The Decide card (business/decide.js on the Board + ZEUS pages). Claude keeps this list. A tap only posts an owner note (POST /inbox/board on the PC link); Claude applies it next session by the CLAUDE.md rules, then sets status to yes / no / later / done. Nothing here changes a live setting.

items.question: Funded 25K: ask for the full $1,000 payout (at balance $27,100) instead of pinging you at $750?
items.why: Tested 8 payout habits on the same 600 paths: $1,000 asks lose fewer accounts and pay the same or a bit more.
items.impact: About +$1 to +$2 a month, accounts lost 5.3% / 6.3% vs 5.7% / 7.3%; each payout comes 1-2 days later.

items.question: Funded 25K: Zlarior (LIT) trades it too, next to ATLAS?
items.why: First payout comes sooner (14 / 18 sessions vs 18 / 26) and a bit more $ a month, but more 6-month runs end with no payout and 2021-25 is a bit worse.
items.applies: python -X utf8 -m engine.lit25 --funded "<Name>" --start <day> (added DISARMED; you arm it)

items.question: Rapid 25K: Zlarior trades 1 micro and takes profit at the day's room (instead of skipping most trades)?
items.why: Today the 30% best-day guard skips 60-65% of Zlarior's trades there. Banking at the room passes and pays sooner, but fails a little more.
items.impact: +$5 / +$66 a month ($2,317 / $1,038 vs $2,312 / $972); fails in 60 sessions 1.3% / 1.4% vs 0.3% / 0.7%. Only matters once a Rapid 25K is bought.

items.question: Zlarior's 50K: ATLAS trades it too once it is funded (the eval stays Zlarior alone)?
items.why: Two strategies give about 2 winning days a week instead of 1, which the payout rules need. ATLAS in the eval fails more, so funded only.
items.impact: About +$420 / +$450 a month ($1,202 / $1,205 vs $779 / $753); first payout 17 / 15 sessions vs 26 / 23.5.
items.applies: add the ATLAS $500 lane to the 50K's funded account once MFFU funds it (lead wires, Sim first)

items.question: Rapid EOD: ATLAS trades it next to Zlarior from day one?
items.why: Zlarior alone takes about 40 sessions to pass a Rapid EOD 50K; with ATLAS about 22, and the first payout comes about twice as fast.
items.impact: About $5,022 / $2,301 a month vs $815 / $799 with Zlarior alone (per Rapid 50K, after the fee).
items.applies: Rapid preset already built LIT + ATLAS $500; a no turns ATLAS off there

items.question: Rapid funded payouts: always leave $1,000 above the buffer in each Rapid?
items.why: More room means Zlarior trades its full size more often, so the account earns more; accounts lost: 0% either way.
items.impact: +$992 / +$523 a month per Rapid 50K ($6,014 / $2,824 vs $5,022 / $2,301); first payout 2-4 sessions later.
items.applies: Rapid funded payout rule keep $1,000 (preset already uses it; a no lowers it)

items.question: Ask MFFU to say yes in writing: a 2nd Builder 50K and a 2nd 25K eval while the current ones run?
items.why: Their rules allow 10 evals, but a written yes protects the payouts if they ever question it.
items.impact: No $ now; protects every future payout from a rules dispute.
items.applies: Claude drafts the message to MFFU support; you send it

items.question: Let the cloud watch your PC (a tiny free check every 30 min on the backup GitHub repo) so you get a push if the PC goes silent?
items.why: The PC-silent alert is built but needs a cloud runner; the old GitHub account's Actions are off since the suspension. The backup repo's free minutes cover it (~700 of 2,000 a month).
items.impact: $0 (free minutes). Catches a dead PC within 30 min instead of days (it was silent Nov 7-17 unnoticed).
